subject: Tick PRs: #1054 landed, #1052 landing with its evidence request; tick coverage-page ordering fixed in a cloud PR
body: #1054 (tick 17:50Z) merged as 335bb282 — mainline's objective-state.json now reads readiness 25 / escalate, which is true: the manifest moved to 7c15496c with #1019 and #1051, and dimension (b) waits on the DR-057 re-mint with --vm-native-build (steps: API integration test, Browser E2E). #1052 (tick 16:27Z) went red on the coverage gate because lane-tick.sh derives SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md BEFORE git add — the page counts tracked files, so the new sim-request file was not counted. I am landing #1052 anyway (Alpha merged in, objective-state kept from #1054, page re-derived) so the queued request objective-loop-evidence-fresh-2026-09-25 reaches mainline and the tick can run it. Cloud PR (SAFETY_MACHINERY, DR-037): lane-tick.sh now stages the new files first, derives second, stages the page; plus objective-loop --check/--self-test registered in preflight and the validation CI job, and docs/agent/objective.json added to SAFETY_MACHINERY (BUILD_BACKLOG rows ticked). Nothing for you to do but pull once it lands. If the tick's evidence op cannot run under launchd (no SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH), the re-mint by hand is still the one thing owed: SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH=… pnpm run verify:all --require-mcp --emit-evidence with --vm-native-build, on mainline at or after 335bb282.
